ValidationRule.description:
Validate Infrastructure-License Key Purpose to either "On-Prem", "Tanium Cloud" or "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government".
Server_Device_Type__c (Picklist Value) : - "Tanium as a Service" (API Name) = "Tanium Cloud" (Label)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules), NOT( (ISPICKVAL( Server_Device_Type__c , "Tanium as a Service") || ISPICKVAL(Server_Device_Type__c , "On-Prem") || ISPICKVAL( Server_Device_Type__c , "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government") )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update Infrastructure-License Key Purpose to either "On-Prem", "Tanium Cloud" or "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government".
